heading: SGB 2018-19 Series III Redemption: Understanding Your Gold Bond Returns
tldr: The Sovereign Gold Bond (SGB) 2018-19 Series III has completed its eight-year tenure and is being redeemed today, November 13, 2026.
Investors in this particular series stand to earn substantial capital gains, reportedly up to 348%, in addition to the regular interest income.
The redemption price for SGBs is determined by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) based on the average closing price of 999 purity gold over the last three business days.
SGBs offer a unique combination of potential gold price appreciation, a fixed interest rate, and specific tax benefits upon maturity.
Understanding the full redemption process and the associated tax implications is crucial for all SGB investors.
